name: Italy
summary: Southern European Mediterranean nation with the Po Valley industrial plain. Atmospheric stagnation bounded by the Alps creates chronic winter particulate accumulation.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 3.08x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Po Valley meteorological inversion basin traps industrial and vehicular pollution.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; hottest calendar year on record in CNR-ISAC Italian national series.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Mediterranean climate hotspot warming at +0.47 °C per decade over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.8% share of global fossil emissions; down 28% from 2005 peak.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Near the European Union average; industrial gas and transport efficiency improving.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Forested area ~95,000 km²; continuous woodland expansion across Apennine and Alpine foothills.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Solar PV provided 10.6%, conventional hydro 12.8%, wind 7.9%, and historic Tuscan geothermal 2.1%.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 200 people/km²; urban population fraction is 71.7%.
